description.value: Beanery is a coffeehouse and eatery serving gourmet sandwiches and thin-crust pizzas with takeout and pickup options available. Located in a plaza on Panorama Drive in North Vancouver, it's a convenient stop for touring cyclists seeking a quick meal.
